archetypes.name: process-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 orphan cleanup depends on signal and process-group sequencing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 cleanup flow from design-step3-review.sh through run-step3-review.sh. Focus on whether monitor-mode changes, process-group teardown, and the best-effort tmpdir kill helper run in the intended order on normal and EXIT paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: tmpdir-validation
archetypes.rationale: The new cleanup CLI can terminate processes and relies on strict design tmpdir validation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/finalize.py kill_background_processes_main for path validation and kill scope. Check that invalid, broad, symlinked, or non-design paths cannot reach kill_session_background_processes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
